description: This file contains a JUnit test class named ContextWithModuleTest that extends BaseContextSensitiveTest. It is designed to test the Behavior of Context.loadClass(String) method when modules are loaded, verifying that classes are loaded with the appropriate class loader (ModuleClassLoader). It manages setup and teardown of modules for testing and verifies class loading behavior related to OpenMRS modules.

classes.name: ContextWithModuleTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that extends BaseContextSensitiveTest. It sets up modules before each test, tears down afterward, and contains a test to verify that a specific class is loaded with the correct class loader.

methods.name: startupBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the modules before each test using ModuleUtil.startup.

methods.name: cleanupAfterEachTest
methods.description: Cleans up and shuts down modules after each test using ModuleUtil.shutdown.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set module load properties, specifying test modules for the test environment.

methods.name: loadClass_shouldLoadClassWithOpenmrsClassLoader
methods.description: Test method that loads a class via Context.loadClass and asserts the class loader is a ModuleClassLoader.
